outputHint: Strip PII from completions before they reach the client

precedence.title: Policy order

key.title: API key override
key.hint: If the request's API key has an override, only that applies. Project and company overrides are ignored.

project.title: Project override
project.hint: Otherwise the override of the project the key belongs to applies.

org.title: Company override
org.hint: Otherwise the override of the company the key belongs to applies.

global.title: Global policy
global.hint: Otherwise the global policy at the top of this tab applies.

precedence.replace: An override fully replaces the inherited policy, including mode, output redaction, and entities. An override without selected entities uses the default set.

actionLabel: {action, select, block {Block} mask {Mask} flag {Flag only} other {{action}}}
actionHint: Block rejects prompts with 400 guardrail_blocked and withholds responses. Mask replaces the match. Flag only lets it through and marks the request log.

injection.title: Prompt injection
injection.hint: Heuristics for common injection phrases in English and German, checked in user and tool content. System and developer instructions are not checked.
injection.actionHint: Block rejects the request with 400 guardrail_blocked before it reaches the model. Flag only lets it through and marks the request log.
injection.checksHint: Without a selection, every check runs.
injection.check: {check, select, instruction_override {Overriding instructions} prompt_leak {System prompt extraction} role_hijack {Jailbreak role play} delimiter {Fake chat delimiters} hidden_text {Hidden Unicode text} other {{check}}}

secrets.title: Secrets in responses
secrets.hint: Checks model output for credentials before it reaches the client. This works independently of PII output redaction.
secrets.entitiesHint: Without a selection, every detector runs.

content.policyHint: Applies to every request unless its API key, project, or company has an override.
content.logsHint: Request logs list every match in prompts and responses. A blocked response ends with finish reason content_filter (stop reason refusal on Messages), and stored log content keeps masked text masked.
content.streamHint: Streams are checked chunk by chunk with a short look-back. A blocked stream stops at the match, so text sent before it has already reached the client. Masking only covers matches within one chunk.
content.overridesHint: Give a company, a project, or a single API key its own guardrails. Each request uses exactly one set, chosen in this order:
content.overridesEmpty: No overrides yet. Every request uses the global guardrails.
content.overrideHint: These guardrails fully replace the inherited ones for the selected company, project, or API key: prompt injection, secret checks, and every rule.
content.replace: An override fully replaces the inherited guardrails. Rules are not merged, so copy the rules you want to keep.
content.state: {enabled, select, true {{action, select, block {Block} mask {Mask} flag {Flag only} other {On}}} other {Off}}
